statement: rule section: CSS/SCSS Formatting Rules
subject: CSS/SCSS Formatting Rules

statement: Dead Code Audit Rules: Treat a CSS selector as removable only after checking Liquid templates, snippets, layout files, JS-generated markup, and settings HTML.
subject: Dead Code Audit Rules

statement: Dead Code Audit Rules: Do not count CSS-only occurrences as real usage.
subject: Dead Code Audit Rules

statement: Dead Code Audit Rules: Remove companion keyframes/modifier selectors when the only component that used them has been deleted.
subject: Dead Code Audit Rules

statement: Dead Code Audit Rules: Keep Swiper, open/active/loading, and other runtime state classes only when a JS path or third-party library can add them.
subject: Dead Code Audit Rules

statement: rule section: Property Count Rules
subject: Property Count Rules

statement: rule section: Spacing Rules
subject: Spacing Rules

statement: rule section: Short Rules (< 4 properties)
subject: Short Rules (< 4 properties)

statement: rule section: Long Rules (4+ properties)
subject: Long Rules (4+ properties)

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Do not create thin one-paragraph pages for footer or navigation links.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Each page must have a clear `h1`, short introduction, and at least three meaningful content sections.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Use varied HTML structures where useful: paragraphs, lists, ordered steps, tables, blockquotes, and `details/summary` FAQ blocks.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Match the page structure to the page purpose. A shipping page should include scope, process, and notes. A buying guide should include steps, checklist, and support CTA. A brand page should include positioning, values, and customer fit.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Avoid fake claims, unverified guarantees, invented addresses, invented certifications, or exact delivery/payment promises unless the merchant provides them.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: If a detail is not confirmed, write it as an operational note that can be updated later instead of fabricating specifics.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Use plain HTML in `body_html`; do not add Liquid, scripts, iframe embeds, or theme-specific fallback logic inside admin page content.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Prefer Haravan-safe tags: `div`, `h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `p`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`, and `blockquote`.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Avoid HTML5 structural/interactive tags in admin page content unless verified on that shop. Haravan may strip tags such as `article`, `section`, `header`, and `details`, which can remove content unexpectedly.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Keep class names optional and generic. If classes are used, namespace them by project or page group, for example `lb-page-content`.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Preserve Vietnamese punctuation and accents. Create or update page content from UTF-8 files/scripts, not from shell snippets that may corrupt encoding.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Content Page Rules: Use stable, human-readable handles for footer pages, for example `ve-chung-toi`, `huong-dan-mua-hang`, `chinh-sach-van-chuyen`.
subject: Haravan Content Page Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: `product.media`, `media.media_type`, and `media.preview_image` are valid for Lumiere Beauty.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: `routes.*` is allowed when every output has a concrete `default` URL fallback.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Parenthesized Liquid conditions are allowed; do not downgrade them by default.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Asset chains like `{{ 'image.png' | img_url: 'large' | asset_url }}` are valid in Haravan for this project.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Render `{{ content_for_header }}` directly. Do not rewrite injected header markup unless a concrete Haravan runtime bug requires it.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: In `templates/index.liquid`, do not add fallback product/article/menu/text/image content after a section is dynamic.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Do not use `no-image.png` or old Stitch demo images as fallback images on the homepage.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Do not use `default:` for fallback homepage copy, handles, images, or menu labels.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: The only approved homepage `default:` exception is a `routes.*` URL guard such as `routes.account_url | default: '/account'`.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Use `include`, not Shopify OS 2.0 `render`.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Use `url_param_escape` or `url_escape`; do not use `url_encode`.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: Haravan Liquid Project Rules: Avoid unsupported cleanup filters such as `remove_last`; build comma-separated JSON with loop/flag logic instead.
subject: Haravan Liquid Project Rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Applies to all HTML tags (images, inputs, buttons, links, SVG, custom elements).
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Break lines between different attribute groups (not by count)
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Keep related attributes from same group on one line
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: One group per line (or combine small groups if logical)
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Indent continuation lines with 1 tab
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Sort attributes within groups by priority
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Group 1 (Content/Source) always on first line with opening tag
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Each subsequent group on new line if present
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Small related groups can share a line (e.g., Dimensions + Styling)
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Close tag on last attribute line
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Boolean attributes stay boolean (e.g., `disabled`, `required`, `checked`).
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: HTML attribute formatting rules: Prefer semantic a11y attributes (`aria-label`, `aria-expanded`, `role`) near the top per order above.
subject: HTML attribute formatting rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: All non-icon images must use `small` or larger presets. Reserve `pico`/`ico` (and `thumb` only if absolutely icon-like) for tiny icons/badges.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Haravan accepts theme asset image chains such as `{{ 'file.png' | img_url: 'large' | asset_url }}`. Do not flag this order as an error in this project.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: For fixed asset logos (e.g., footer certs, Zalo QR): `asset_url` alone is fine when no resize preset is needed.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: For settings images: use dot notation `settings.image_id` only. Bracket notation `settings['...']` does NOT exist in Liquid. Use brackets only for dynamic access with variables: `settings[variable_name]`.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Do choose the smallest preset that stays sharp at the rendered size.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Do pair nearby presets in `srcset` to avoid blurry/oversized downloads.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Do add explicit `width`/`height` when you know the rendered box to reduce CLS.
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Don’t use custom dimensions like `120x` or `50x50` (the platform will reject them).
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Icons/badges: pico or ico (thumb only if needed for legacy icon sprites)
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Small UI blocks (sticky bar, minicart): small → medium
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: Product cards/grids: small → medium
subject: Haravan image size rules

statement: Haravan image size rules: PDP main media: large → grande (fall back to original for zoom/lightbox)
subject: Haravan image size rules
